verdict.rationale: ADK ships its own built-in development UI (`adk web`) that is documented as helping developers debug agent runs, which is the closest first-party observability surface in the evidence. Nothing documents a trace view of each LLM call and tool invocation. Callbacks for logging and monitoring are only developer building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: explicit per-run trace view of every LLM call, explicit tool-invocation tracing, OpenTelemetry or observability-platform export, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trace every LLM call and tool invocation of an agent run in an observability UI

citations.quote: A built-in development UI to help you test, evaluate, debug, and showcase your agent(s).
